model_form: Evolutionary-algorithm closure: T1 plus a T2 term scaled by a bounded strain function plus a small T3 term.
reference: J. Weatheritt, R. Sandberg (2016), "A novel evolutionary algorithm applied to algebraic modifications of the RANS stress-strain relationship", J. Comput. Phys. 325, 22-37. doi:10.1016/j.jcp.2016.08.015
